title: Selective quantitative N-functionalization of unprotected α-amino acids using NHC-Ir(III) catalyst
author: Saavedra, Bermejo-López, et al.

steps.title: Dry TFE solvent
steps.instruction: Dry 2,2,2‑trifluoroethanol (TFE) by adding activated 4 Å molecular sieves and keep it dry for use as the solvent in the synthesis of N‑alkylated amino acids.

steps.title: Prepare anhydrous solvents
steps.instruction: Obtain anhydrous solvents from the VAC solvent purification system (when specified) and use them for the NHC‑Ir(III) catalyst synthesis and its activation prior to the N‑alkylation reaction.

steps.title: Observe safety precautions
steps.instruction: Perform all reactions in a fume hood while wearing gloves, goggles, and a lab coat because toxic and volatile organic compounds are used.
